Docs

Everything on mixos.dev that is not one component's documentation lives here. A component's page is at /<component>/, for example /mix/ for the Mix language or /term/ for the terminal. Every page is also published as Markdown at its source path, and /llms.txt lists them all. The site URL layout decision fixes these addresses.

Guides

  • Try it beside your desktop: run MixOS as a small signed image on its own virtual terminal, next to the desktop you already use.
  • Driving apps over the Bus: how an agent drives a native MixOS app through Bus commands.

Indexes

  • Components: every component, with its kind, install profiles, source and page.
  • Desktop and Server: the components each install profile includes.

Decisions

Public decision records are the authority for the MixOS tree. The foundational ones:

  • Source layout and naming
  • egui applications, engine first
  • Commands take parameters and return results
  • One repository, install profiles
  • One system binary
  • Site URL layout

Every decision record is listed in /llms.txt and in the repository.
